item.title: Renter-Friendly Kitchen Organization: Magnetic Spice Rack Solutions That Require No Drilling
item.description: A small rental kitchen can feel crowded long before it actually runs out of storage. Spices are a good example: they are used often, but a drawer full of small jars is difficult to scan, while leaving them on the counter creates clutter. A magnetic spice rack can solve that specific problem without drilling into a wall or cabinet. The key is to treat it as a small storage system, not simply a decorative row of jars.
